The issue asks to design and build an entire dApp from scratch: Harberger-tax keyword-NFT smart contracts, a CoinMarketCap/ideamarket.io-style frontend with MetaMask, 'proof-of-lost-keys', mainnet deployment, and connection to the owner's domain. Payment is explicitly contingent on non-code outcomes ('Paid when: 1) Live on mainnet 2) Decent-looking front end 3) Connected to my domain') and the item is framed as a $1,500 open bounty/grant ("$1,500 bounty, go!") — i.e. a generic product idea + proposal/bounty request rather than a reproducible defect, specific bounded feature, or focused maintenance task in this repo. The real application codebase does not live here at all: this repo is a README-only placeholder, development happens on GitLab (https://gitlab.com/IdeaMarket/app-v2, HTTP 200), and the GitHub repo is used only as a Gitcoin PR mirror (open PRs #15/#17/#19 titled '[Gitcoin] ...' whose bodies state 'the original Gitlab PR can be found here', all from competitor fork Bobface/ideamarkets). Because the target repo has no code or toolchain, no environment baseline (baseline_tests), no build/lint, and no defect-specific regression reproduction (regression_plan) can be constructed, and no concrete repository change is requested. Per the blocked criteria (generic product idea without a repository change; grant/proposal request; already-competing work), the checkout is left unchanged at master and no work branch is created.
